summary.text: Reena Szczepanski is a Democratic state representative from District 47 who has represented the district since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served as House majority leader since January 2025 and has a public health background.

paragraphs.text: Reena Szczepanski grew up in Decatur, Georgia, lives in Santa Fe and earned a bachelor's degree in human biology from Brown University.

Her career experience includes serving as president of the New Mexico Public Health Association, hepatitis program manager for the New Mexico Department of Health, state director of the Drug Policy Alliance and executive director of Emerge New Mexico.
She volunteered as chair of the Santa Fe County Health Policy and Planning Commission and as an AmeriCorps Community Health Corps volunteer.
Szczepanski was selected as House majority leader effective January 21, 2025.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the State Government, Elections and Indian Affairs Committee, the Rules and Order of Business Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
